title: It's what you do from five to nine that matters
caption: Tradever's CEO on 9-to-5s, side hustles and learning a skill. #tradever #propfirm #daytrading #futurestrading #ad @tradeverfunding @laythbanks

slides.text: Your *nine to five* isn't the problem.
It's what you do from your five to nine that matters.
You can make a lot more money by learning a skill set and giving yourself that time.
There is not a skill set in the world that I think is better than learning how to day trade.
